notes: Tuition: The DAAD page states '500 EUR' per semester for applicants from non-EU countries, Switzerland and the United Kingdom, but the programme's own page (th-deg.de/ese-b-en) states 'No tuition fees, only student union fee'. The institution-wide page confirms the €500 as a 'DIT service fee' charged to non-EU/EEA students, i.e. a service fee rather than tuition; no unambiguous programme tuition figure could be extracted, so tuition is omitted. The application deadline 15 July is given as a recurring day/month without a year and is listed in the general bachelor table (for all applicants, including those checking DAAD eligibility for foreign qualifications). The document list comes from the general international-applicant section of the application page, not from the programme page itself. The French and Spanish language tests named on the DAAD page (TOEIC, telc English B2, PTE Academic 59) confirm English proficiency only; no French-language requirement is stated for this programme.
